name: Potato Casserole
description: A hearty potato casserole made with frozen hash browns, cream soups, and grated cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a shallow pan until well combined.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side
